title: Hatsune Miku — At Least Let Me〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I think... I heard someone's feelings just now. This means that somewhere, another SEKAI has been born.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe, I wonder what kind of SEKAI it is. What would that SEKAI's version of me be like?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... I think I might go take a look...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That flash just now...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: ...Oh, here it is! I knew it was a fragment of a feeling.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But it looks like the color has faded a little. There's even cracks on it...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Maybe the feeling it came from was already unstable. It even looks like it'll disappear at any moment...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There must be some sort of meaning to me finding it at this point in time.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Whoever you are that bears these feelings... Whoever you are that bears these feelings... I'd like to learn more about what you're going through.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Phew... That fragment was so unstable, I didn't think I would make it...but I'm glad I did.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Even so, this place is so dark and lonely...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh... There're sheets of paper on the floor.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
“Post-Graduation Plans”... “First Preference”...
There's nothing written underneath them...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And this is...an answer sheet for a test.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It looks like the type where you mark your answers by filling in the circles but it's only filled up halfway...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm? There's a computer over there.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Um, “School Achievements”... “Reason for Application”...? These segments were left blank.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hmm...
I guess the person who holds these feelings is a student?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, there's another computer over here too. But there's a lot of words this time...

rows.Speaker: Computer Screen
rows.Line: “I did as I was told, and followed him into the alley. Right at that moment, I closed my eyes without thinking.”

rows.Speaker: Computer Screen
rows.Line: “The sun was setting. Its blazing hue painted the alley in vermillion...”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is this...a novel?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But that's all that's on here. I guess the writer isn't finished...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There's something over there too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow, it's a really cute animal illustration. There's even manga here too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But...the coloring on this illustration looks unfinished. And not all of the panels of the manga are done either...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... Maybe this fragment of a feeling is from someone who got tired of all of these?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm going to keep looking around for a bit longer.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There really is a lot of stuff in this fragment's SEKAI. There's an unfinished oil painting and even a single sneaker here too...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I understand now... These aren't just feelings from one person. I think all of these are fragments of a lot of people's feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So that means all of these people both feel and share the same feelings. But...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Why does it seem like there's no one solid emotion?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Even fragments of feelings that didn't give birth to a SEKAI would even have the slightest bit of emotion...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: When the feelings of people converge into one place, they naturally get bigger and stronger and yet...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: For some reason, I can barely feel anything from any of these things here...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Now that I think about it, this fragment of a feeling was quite pale. Does that have anything to do with this?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm going to try to see if I can feel something...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (No matter how small or faint it may be, I know it's there somewhere...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I think I felt it! Even if it was just a little bit!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm pretty sure it was from somewhere around here... Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There's music sheets scattered all over the place... Good thing I noticed before I stepped on any.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, let's see... Looks like only 4 sheets fell onto the floor.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Seems to be unfinished just like all of the other stuff I found. Also...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This melody... It sounds so painful. Whoever wrote this must have been going through a lot.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It seems like they're lost... Or troubled.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I don't think it was about composing, though...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But, I finally found something that emits some emotion.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There has to be more... Oh!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's an MP3 player! Good, it still works too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (If it's some sort of musical object, there's a higher chance I can feel something from it.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Whoever you are, I'm here to have a look at what you're going through.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's quiet but... I can hear something.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I think...it's someone singing. A boy, maybe. It sounds like he's singing acapella.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I get it now! He must've recorded himself practicing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh... But he was a little off-time just now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (It also sounds like he noticed. And that's why he's practicing this part over and over.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I bet this boy is a hard worker.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But... I can really hear his frustration and impatience from the way he sings...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I think I know what feelings the fragment originated from now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (The feelings that created this SEKAI were definitely...)
